titles.native: 現世守護神 ぴーひょろ一家

description:
Based on Kaori Kimeki's fantasy manga serialized in "Princess" magazine.

Note: The first episode was released theatrically on July 9, 1988 together with the digest edition of the Aim for the Ace 2 OVA series. The full series was released on VHS on September 1, 1988.
